svg.aria-label: A Claude plugin and skill that reads a job description, checks your public repositories, and writes an ATS-ready one-page LaTeX resume from your real work, with an opt-in target resume and gap report that show what to build next. Why it is interesting: It compiles the LaTeX and measures how full the page is, trimming or enriching until it fills exactly one page, without ever shrinking fonts or margins. It refuses to invent jobs, dates, grades or numbers.
